facts.fact: Ordonnance n°00002/PR/2020 of 31 January 2020, published in the Journal Officiel n°60 Bis of 27 March 2020, amends and completes the 2011 data protection law Loi n°001/2011 (adding rights to portability and erasure, a data protection delegate, and fines of CFA 1 million to 100 million); it was later superseded by Loi n°025/2023.

The ordonnance sets the organs of the Commission Nationale pour la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (bureau, plenary, restricted formation, provincial offices), creates its levy (RPPVP, CFA 1,000 per person a year) and its accounting agency; it names no appointment of members.
